test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting in a straight row, facing north. O is sitting to the immediate right of N. P is sitting to the immediate right of O. Q is sitting to the immediate right of P. R is sitting to the immediate left of N. If there are only five people sitting to the right of M, who is at the extreme right end of the row?
solution: The sitting arrangement as per the given information: 1. O is sitting to the immediate right of N, R is sitting to the immediate left of N, P is sitting to the immediate right of O and Q is sitting to the immediate right of P.
